description: Full-window evaluation dataset for Pegboard: the Finch Street Café schedule from 30 December 2024 to 17 January 2027 and two years of one employee account (1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026), with handoffs, coworker requests, manager answers, decisions and changes, time off, availability, preferences, notifications and the activity log. Synthetic; separate from the smoke fixture (fixtures/minimal.json).

sources.description: Generated by dev/dataset.cjs: an invented café, its staff and a seeded two-year timeline (weekly postings, Noor's covers, trades, releases and pickups, coworker requests, manager answers, decisions, changes and cancellations, time off, availability and preference changes), applied through the App's own tools and events. No real person, workplace, schedule or website; nothing collected.

generation.method: seeded scripted replay through the App business functions (mulberry32 generator)

transformations: None: seed.json is the App state exactly as the replay leaves it, written as compact JSON (sha256 aa84c05745f94b0d1c767e097875a931103cfe0c97966b4d7a2b3978026abefa).

review.notes: Automated checks (seed schema and rules every 250 steps and at the end, dev/coverage.cjs, tests/dataset.integration.cjs) do not replace human review of realism: the schedule pattern, the frequency and wording of requests and decisions, and that the workplace and every person are fictional.
